name: Scoriaceous-Erg

civilization.name: Ysolde Dominion
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: A battered sphere of bare stone, cratered so densely that old impacts overlap like raindrops on a pond. Through it all runs orbital debris ring, stark under a black sky.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
Nothing about gravity well anomaly appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Whoever solves this anomaly will rewrite several sciences. Whoever blunders into it will merely end several careers.
